title: grants.yaml
description: The factory's grants: what each allows in plain words, its limits, and which seats hold it.

grants.description: The grants, each with its own id.

id.description: The grant's id: lower-case letters and digits joined by single hyphens, at most 64 characters.

allows.description: What the grant allows, in plain words. Must not be blank.

limits.description: The grant's limits, in plain words. Must not be blank.

seats.description: The seats that hold the grant, by seat id, at least one, each once. Each must name the grant too.

items.description: A seat id: lower-case letters and digits joined by single hyphens, at most 64 characters.
